summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Long VIAV Daily ETF (VIAG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of Viavi Solutions Inc. (NASDAQ: VIAV) stock, less fees and expenses VIAG was launched on Jul 7, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.
